connector.name: Vivory Verification Gateway
connector.registryDescription: 98 MCP tools for verifiable AI: citations, law, KYB, peer review, forecast, media provenance.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package vivory-mcp-verification. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the jayjodev account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: VIVORY_API_KEY
env.description: Optional Vivory Pro API key for higher daily limits (10,000/day Pro vs 100/day anonymous). Get one at api.vivory.app/dashboard.

env.name: VIVORY_API_BASE
env.description: Override the upstream gateway URL (default: https://api.vivory.app/api). Useful for self-hosted Vivory backends.
